boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Marywood University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with currently published late availability in Scranton.

cards.title: Main Dining Room
cards.subtitle: Marywood University, 2300 Adams Avenue
cards.notes: Use the on-campus late-night station Sunday through Thursday; confirm dining eligibility and payment option before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining option whose published schedule includes a dedicated late-night service period.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists Main Dining Room late-night service Sunday–Thursday from 8:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published late-night service is Sunday–Thursday, 8:00–11:00 p.m.; meal swipes and other payment forms are listed.

cards.title: Denny's on Scranton Carbondale Highway
cards.subtitle: 410 Scranton Carbondale Highway, Scranton
cards.notes: A 24-hour diner option for a sit-down meal or takeout; check the live ordering cutoff before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: The published location schedule runs essentially all day and night.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists this Scranton location's store hours as 12:00 a.m.–11:58 p.m. every day and describes it as open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Published store hours are 12:00 a.m.–11:58 p.m. daily; online-order acceptance can have a separate cutoff.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Olive Street
cards.subtitle: 2 Olive Street, Scranton
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru or delivery after the dining room closes; the official listing publishes later drive-thru hours.
cards.short_summary: A Scranton Taco Bell with a consistently late drive-thru schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 2 Olive Street drive-thru as open until 2:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is published until 2:00 a.m. daily; the dining room has earlier hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Davis Street
cards.subtitle: 733 Davis Street, Scranton
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest service, and check the day because published closing times differ on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A second Scranton Taco Bell with late drive-thru availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 733 Davis Street drive-thru until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours end at 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in ends earlier.

cards.title: Shams Hot Chicken
cards.subtitle: 1657 North Keyser Avenue, Scranton
cards.notes: Order a halal meal for pickup before midnight Sunday through Friday; Saturday's published closing time is earlier.
cards.short_summary: A local halal-food option with late weekday and Sunday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Shams Hot Chicken lists its Scranton location as open until 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Friday and until 11:00 p.m. Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published Scranton hours: 11:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. Sunday–Friday and 12:00 p.m.–11:00 p.m. Saturday; holidays may vary.

cards.title: Joe's Kwik Mart on North Keyser
cards.subtitle: 701 North Keyser Avenue, Scranton
cards.notes: Use this convenience stop for hot food or packaged snacks when restaurant kitchens are closed; indoor seating is listed.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store that explicitly lists hot food among its amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Joe's Kwik Mart lists its #166 Scranton location as open 24 hours daily and identifies hot food as an amenity.
cards.access_notes: Published as open 24 hours daily; the location lists hot food and indoor seating.

cards.title: CK's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1201 Mulberry Street, Scranton
cards.notes: Place a takeout order before midnight Monday through Saturday; this pizzeria's official page lists no Sunday service.
cards.short_summary: A Mulberry Street pizzeria with a published midnight closing time on operating days.
cards.evidence_claim: CK's Pizza lists hours of 4:00 p.m.–12:00 a.m. Monday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: CK's Pizza menu and contact page
cards.access_notes: Published hours are Monday–Saturday, 4:00 p.m.–12:00 a.m.; no Sunday hours are listed.

cards.title: Scranton Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 1225 Mulberry Street, Scranton
cards.notes: Use online ordering or pickup before the published 10:30 p.m. closing time; verify that day's full-hours listing first.
cards.short_summary: A named pizza shop whose own ordering page posts a 10:30 p.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Scranton Pizzeria's ordering page lists its hours as 11:00 a.m.–10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The official ordering page displays 11:00 a.m.–10:30 p.m.; review the current full-hours link before travel.

cards.title: Wendy's on Davis Street
cards.subtitle: 703 Davis Street, Scranton
cards.notes: Check the location page for the day-specific schedule before going; the official city listing shows a midnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Davis Street fast-food location with a published midnight close on one weekly schedule entry.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official Scranton locator lists the 703 Davis Street restaurant and shows an 'Open Until 12:00 AM' schedule entry.
cards.access_notes: The official city locator displays an 'Open Until 12:00 AM' entry; confirm the specific day and service mode before travel.

cards.title: Wendy's on Wyoming Avenue
cards.subtitle: 944 Wyoming Avenue, Scranton
cards.notes: Use the official locator to confirm the day-specific hours and service mode; it posts a midnight closing-time entry.
cards.short_summary: A separate Wyoming Avenue location with a published late closing schedule entry.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official Scranton locator lists the 944 Wyoming Avenue restaurant and shows an 'Open Until 12:00 AM' schedule entry.
cards.access_notes: The official city locator displays an 'Open Until 12:00 AM' entry; confirm the specific day and service mode before travel.
